posts.text:
To every first responder on September 11, 2001: thank you for your courage, sacrifice, and heroism.

Every member of the FDNY, NYPD, Port Authority and EMS: we will Never Forget you.

America does not bend. America does not break. And on September 11, it was the men and women in those uniforms who proved it. Floor by floor, block by block, hour by hour.

They are the reason we promise to Never Forget. It is a promise we make to every hero who answered the call this day and every single day since

posts.text:
25 years.

It has been 25 years since radical Islamists flew planes into the Twin Towers on September 11, 2001, carrying out the most prolific act of terrorism on American soil. 9/11 was more than an attack on buildings. It was an attack on freedom, on faith, and on the very soul of our country.

2,977 innocent American lives lost. First responders, FDNY, NYPD, Port Authority, EMS, and civilians.

In the darkest of times, through the greatest of losses, America did not fall. It never will.

God
